description: This is a Python source file for an ERPNext report module named 'item_wise_sales_register'. It contains functions to generate a sales report, including data retrieval, tax calculations, and report formatting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, calling internal functions to gather data and format the report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on filters and additional columns.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on report filters.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches sales invoice items from the database based on conditions.

methods.name: get_delivery_notes_against_sales_order
methods.description: Retrieves delivery notes associated with sales order details.

methods.name: get_grand_total
methods.description: Calculates the total grand amount for the report period.

methods.name: get_deducted_taxes
methods.description: Retrieves list of taxes marked as 'Deduct'.

methods.name: get_tax_accounts
methods.description: Calculates tax amounts and rates for items, returning detailed tax info.

methods.name: add_total_row
methods.description: Adds total rows for grouped data in the report.

methods.name: get_display_value
methods.description: Generates display string for grouped report fields.

methods.name: get_group_by_and_display_fields
methods.description: Determines grouping and display fields based on filter.

methods.name: add_sub_total_row
methods.description: Accumulates subtotal data for grouped report sections.
